title: FrameworkEffector
description: Framework base Archetype for Effector — a Structure's outbound causal port. Inherits gsm/Effector through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Effector statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Effector, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
